summary: I also define anyone as #IndieWeb for having a place they control online, preferably from their own domain. All the other stuff is just cool extras that eliminate dependance on the corporate social web. Own your content, be in control, make better connections
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I also define anyone as #IndieWeb for having a place they control online, preferably from their own domain.

All the other stuff is just cool extras that eliminate dependance on the corporate social web.

Own your content, be in control, make better connections
